primes_3_5.says: 3 and 5 are prime numbers greater than 2.

even_factor.says: A product of whole numbers with an even factor is even.
even_factor.z3: All([x, y], [(3, 5)], Implies(parity(x) == even or parity(y) == even, parity(x * y) == even))

rem_def.says: An even number leaves remainder 0 when divided by 2, an odd one 1.

odd_product.says: A product of two odd whole numbers is odd.
odd_product.z3: All([x, y], [(3, 5)], Implies(parity(x) == odd and parity(y) == odd, parity(x * y) == odd))

p_prime.says: p is a prime number greater than 2.
